headline: Ethics board sends complaint 247 to a formal hearing

meeting.summary: The Board of Ethics moved complaint 247 to a formal hearing and voted to send out its current gift guide and campaign restrictions.
meeting.recap: The Board of Ethics was called to order at 12:37 p.m. on October 9, 2024.[[0:00:30]] A resident who said he directs Maui Causes testified on complaint item 24-10.[[0:02:47]] He said he sent the board a petition with 161 local signatures supporting the complaint.[[0:04:39]] The chair stopped a second testifier, a complainant, because board rules make the complaint confidential.[[0:11:22]] The board agreed to hear that complainant at the start of executive session, a closed-door discussion.[[0:14:23]] The board reported a 7-0 vote to move complaint 247 to a formal hearing.[[0:16:43]] It reported a 7-0 vote to hold an informal hearing on complaint 24-10.[[0:17:36]] The board voted to ratify, or confirm, its closed-session decisions.[[0:19:09]] The board voted to send out its current gift guide and memo.[[0:23:55]] The board voted to send out its current campaign restrictions.[[0:25:34]] Staff offered to put on the next agenda how to handle requests for confidential complaint details.[[0:32:29]] The next meeting is November 13, 2024, at 12:30 p.m. at the Planning Department conference room, 255 High Street.[[0:33:00]] A meeting planned for later this week was canceled.[[0:33:14]]
decided: The board went into executive session, but the captions do not clearly show whether or how a vote was taken.
The board reported it moved complaint 247 to a formal hearing.
The board reported it deferred a second item until complaint 247 is resolved.
The board reported it dismissed item 3B1.
The board reported it voted to issue an advisory opinion.
The board reported it approved all of the disclosure statements.
The board voted to ratify the executive session decisions.
The board voted to send out the gift guide and memo as currently written and take up other ideas at the next meeting.
The board voted to send out the campaign restrictions as currently written and discuss them further at the next meeting.
The board voted to accept the item 6B instructions without changes.
The board voted to approve its regular and executive session minutes.
The board voted to accept a financial disclosure statement from one filer whose name is unclear in the captions.
The board voted to acknowledge receipt of a lobbyist registration.
The board voted to end the meeting.
meeting.next: Other ideas for the gift guide will be considered at the next meeting. The campaign restrictions will be discussed further at the next meeting. How to handle requests for confidential complaint information will be put on the next agenda.
